description: This file defines a React hook `useIsTabletOrMobileScreen` to determine if the current device screen is a tablet or mobile device. It also exports a utility function `getIsTabletOrMobileScreen` that computes device type based on application context and screen size, utilizing various imported utility functions and application context providers.

methods.name: getIsTabletOrMobileScreen
methods.description: Determines device type (tablet, mobile, or tablet or mobile) based on application context and screen size.

methods.name: useIsTabletOrMobileScreen
methods.description: React hook that subscribes to window resize events and returns device type info via `getIsTabletOrMobileScreen`.
